---
title: "Running on a SLURM cluster"
---

`omero-screen-sbatch` (the script `bin/sbatch_omero_screen.py`) writes a
SLURM job script that runs `omero-screen` and submits it with `sbatch`. It is
set up for the Sussex HPC (job classes, GPU nodes, `@sussex.ac.uk` e-mail);
other clusters will need its template adjusted.

It works from the installed release and from a source checkout alike, and
from any folder: the job runs the programs beside the script with the same
Python that submitted it. Submit from your work space: the job script and its
`.out` log are written there. If you also have a source checkout, don't submit
the release from inside it, or the job picks up the checkout's `.env` files.

```bash
cd /mnt/lustre/users/<group>/$USER        # your work space
omero-screen-sbatch 12345 67890 --stitch --track
```

From a source checkout, run it with the checkout's Python
(`uv run python bin/sbatch_omero_screen.py …`); after a `git pull`, run
`uv sync` before submitting, since the job no longer syncs on its own. No
`.env` file is needed unless you pass `--env` (then `.env.<name>` at the
omero-screen root is required). An `omero-screen submit` command for any
SLURM cluster is in preparation
([#92](https://github.com/HocheggerLab/omero-screen/issues/92)). For
installing on the cluster, see
[On an HPC cluster](installation.qmd#on-an-hpc-cluster).

::: {.callout-note}
This is a `bin/` utility and still uses argparse, unlike the installed
commands. It keeps argparse conventions, including abbreviated options.
:::

By default it submits one job per plate ID.

## Job options

| Option | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| `--class CLASS` | `gpu` | SLURM job class |
| `-u`, `--username USER` | current user | Cluster username |
| `-t`, `--threads N` | 1 | CPU threads; raise it when running without a GPU |
| `--hours N` | 24 | Wall-clock limit in hours |
| `-m`, `--memory N` | 32 | Memory in GB |
| `--gpu` / `--no-gpu` | on | Request a GPU node |
| `--exec` / `--no-exec` | on | Execute the generated script statements |
| `--submit` / `--no-submit` | on | Submit with `sbatch` |
| `--multi-submit` / `--no-multi-submit` | on | One job per plate ID |

The memory you request becomes the job's cgroup limit, which the pipeline reads
to decide whether to [stream the stitch](stitching.qmd#host-memory).

## Pipeline options

These are forwarded to `omero-screen` in every job. They mean the same as in the
[CLI reference](../reference/cli/omero_screen.qmd).

| Option | Forwarded as |
|---|---|
| `--env ENV` | `--env` |
| `--config PATH` | `--config`, resolved to an absolute path and checked at submission |
| `--inference MODEL [MODEL ...]` | `--inference` |
| `--segmentation` | `--segmentation` |
| `--delete` | `--delete` |
| `--cp4`, `--model MODEL` | `--cp4`, `--model` |
| `--stitch`, `--stitch-config PATH` | `--stitch`, `--stitch-config` |
| `--stream-stitch` / `--no-stream-stitch` | the same |
| `--track [MODEL]`, `--track-mode`, `--track-device`, `--track-window`, `--track-batch-size`, `--track-correct` | the same |
